```plato

    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torus_knot
    TorusKnot(t: Angle, p: Number, q: Number): Point3D
    {
        var r = (t * q).Cos + 2.0;
        var x = r * (t * p).Cos;
        var y = r * (t * p).Sin;    
        var z = -(t * q).Sin;
        return (x, y, z);
    }
```
